FX-MAPCHROMA-001.says: The ramp at most 2, all three amounts 100 written and 3 samples: FX-DMAP-002 exactly.

FX-MAPCHROMA-002.says: A white solid at most 2, red 0, green 100, blue 200, 3 samples: red stays put, green is read 2 right and 2 below, blue 4 right and 4 below; the covering is the largest of the three.

FX-MAPCHROMA-003.says: FX-MAPCHROMA-002 with 9 samples: each channel blended over the colours beside it, so between red's and blue's places the fringes run smoothly.

FX-MAPCHROMA-004.says: The ramp, red 50, green 100, blue 150, 3 samples: where the ramp pushes hardest, at its ends, the colours part most.

FX-MAPCHROMA-005.says: FX-MAPCHROMA-004 with 16 samples, an even count: the rainbow.

FX-MAPCHROMA-006.says: The painted map, blue across at most 2.5 and luminance down at most 1.5 (FX-DMAP-008), red -100, green 0, blue 100, 5 samples: red moves against the push, green stays, blue with it.

FX-MAPCHROMA-007.says: The white solid, blue keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 300 at frame 4, the others absent: frame 0 is FX-DMAP-003, then blue parts from the rest.

FX-MAPCHROMA-008.says: FX-MAPCHROMA-002 with Wrap on: what each channel reads from beyond the right or the bottom comes from the other side.

FX-MAPCHROMA-009.says: FX-MAPCHROMA-004 on the holder moved 2 right and 1 down: the same picture, moved.

FX-MAPCHROMA-010.says: FX-MAPCHROMA-005 on an adjustment layer above the holder: the frame is the holder's rectangle, so FX-MAPCHROMA-005.

FX-MAPCHROMA-012.says: All three amounts 50 with 9 samples: no colour parts, the ramp's displacement halved (FX-DMAP-002 at most 1).

FX-MAPCHROMA-013.says: Spectrum keyed from 3 at frame 0 to 11 at frame 4 on FX-MAPCHROMA-002: frame 0 is FX-MAPCHROMA-002, frame 3 9 samples, FX-MAPCHROMA-003.

FX-MAPCHROMA-014.says: No layer named: nothing moves, whatever the amounts.

FX-MAPCHROMA-015.says: Red amount 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAPCHROMA-016.says: Blue amount -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAPCHROMA-017.says: Spectrum 2, below 3. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAPCHROMA-018.says: Spectrum 33, above 32. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAPCHROMA-019.says: Green amount keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 2000 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
